item.title: Version 0.2.1
item.description:
Fixes from a stress test with worst-case data.
- An empty answer now says "No answer came back." instead of showing nothing. - Click a long question's bubble to read all of it; click again to shorten it. - Wide tables fade at the right edge, so you can see there is more to scroll. - ⌘↓ shows earlier questions and ⌘↑ hides them. VoiceOver can reach them too. - While an answer streams, a half-arrived `**`, `~~` or backtick stays hidden until it closes. - Numbered lists that start at 1000 or more render as lists. - Long lists stream more smoothly. - Fixed a crash when a `<details>` section arrived cut off mid-stream.

item.title: Version 0.2.0
item.description:
The first public release.
- Press ⌥⌘Space, ask, read, press Esc. The card slides in from the right edge and gets out of the way. - Runs your own `claude` with your login, settings, skills and connectors. Answers come first, with a few "worth knowing" bullets. - One session all day, reset with ⌘N or at 5 AM. Nothing is saved to disk. - After 3 quiet minutes it opens as just the field; drag the bottom edge down for earlier questions. - Markdown renders while it streams: lists, tables, code, alerts, footnotes and math. - Updates itself through Sparkle, quietly: a dot on ✦ when an update is ready.
